description.en-US: Choose whether Amadeus asks for execution approval. External tools keep their own action gates.
description.zh-CN: 选择 Amadeus 是否请求执行审批；外部工具仍保留自身的动作门禁。

title.zh-CN: 自动批准所有 Work 执行

description.en-US: Automatically approve Amadeus execution requests for every Work, including MCP and shell. Saved across restarts until you turn it off; approvals remain recorded.
description.zh-CN: 自动批准所有 Work 的 Amadeus 执行请求，包括 MCP 和 Shell。跨重启保存，直到手动关闭；审批仍会留痕。
